title: Additional Premium on a Mid-Term Named Non-Owner Policy Package Change
content:
**Policy.** The additional premium for a Named Non-Owner Policy package change during the term is worked out under the package-change increase rule and booked as one additional-premium entry whose reason names the direction of the change: limits increase for a move to a package with a higher six-month base rate and limits decrease for a move to a package with a lower one; a move to a lower base rate whose increase charge under that rule is above zero is charged as additional premium and not returned, and only such a move; every other move to a lower base rate still returns unearned premium as a return-premium entry for the limits decrease, and a reinstatement still re-writes premium under the reinstatement rule.

The increase charge for a package change is worked out only after the term carries the package it moves to.

The increase charge is not worked out until the term's premium ledger carries a re-written premium entry for every reinstatement with a lapse recorded on the term.

**On the term.** The additional-premium entry carries the reason recorded, the amount, the coverage date the charge applies from and the days it covers, stamped with the day's processing date; the term's net written premium rises by the amount booked and the entry shows in the term's premium and fee history.

## Invocation: `book_package_increase_premium_8b98e0ec`
An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `book_package_increase_premium_8b98e0ec` and calls it.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `nonowner_policy_id` | the reference number of the Named Non-Owner Policy term the increase is charged on, as returned by the non-owner policy lookup for the caller | identifier |
| `additional_amount` | the additional premium charged, in US dollars | a positive number with exactly 2 decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent |
| `effective_date` | the coverage date the charge applies from | YYYY-MM-DD, calendar date, no time or time zone |
| `premium_days` | the calendar days of the term the charge covers | an integer of 0 or more, whole days, no decimals |
| `change_direction` | the direction of the package change the charge is for | exactly one of the two values below |

| `change_direction` value | Meaning | Reason recorded |
|---|---|---|
| "higher_base_rate" | the term moved to a package with a higher six-month base rate | limits increase |
| "lower_base_rate" | the term moved to a package with a lower six-month base rate | limits decrease |

**Return.** A one-line confirmation naming the new entry reference number (prefix nli_), the term reference number, the reason recorded, the amount in US dollars with 2 decimals, the coverage date in YYYY-MM-DD, the days covered as a whole number and the term's net written premium in US dollars with 2 decimals once the entry is counted. The presence of the entry reference number means the charge was booked.
